question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

The tension is going to be __crucial__ in determining the fate of your company.
solution:
The correct answer is "**trivial.**"

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym means a word that means the opposite of another word.
 
• Let us now understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• The underlined word is **"crucial" which means something/someone very important.(**महत्वपूर्ण)
 
 
• Example: This game is very crucial for her team.
 
 
 
 
 
• The antonym for "crucial" would be a word that means unimportant or insignificant.
 
 
• **"Trivial" is the word that means unimportant or insignificant,(**मामूली) making it the correct antonym for "crucial."
 
 
• Example: He was punished for a trivial mistake.
 
 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer will be option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In option 1 ,"surgical" means precise or exact.(सुनिश्चितता के साथ संपादित)
 
• In option 2, "decisive" means conclusive or final.(निर्णयक)
 
• In option 4, "pivotal" means central or essential.(केंद्रीय)
